## Required checklist

- [ ] Comparison board created
- [ ] Matching Figma mockups created during the same design milestone
- [ ] Board and Figma direction names, data, device sizes, and states match
- [ ] Principal Figma flow is evaluable on a phone
- [ ] Preferred direction and rationale recorded
- [ ] Rejected directions preserved
- [ ] Interactive phone prototype created from the selected direction
- [ ] Physical-device review completed
- [ ] Production implementation approved
